title: EATF Agent Evidence Package toolkit
description: Open toolkit for creating, inspecting, and offline-verifying Agent Evidence Packages (.aep): TypeScript and Python verifiers, sign/verify/inspect CLIs, JSON schemas, runnable examples, and positive/negative conformance vectors. Version 0.3.0 adds stable machine-readable first-failure codes, a fixed model-based oracle, and a deterministic 21-case decision-path corpus. The preserved confirmatory run records 21/21 oracle matches and 21/21 TypeScript/Python verdict-and-code matches across two accepting paths and 16 distinct rejection states.
notes: Version 0.5.0 adds experiments/ordering, which measures how far a first-failure code depends on the order in which guards run. Guards are evaluated independently by calling the shipped public components, with no verifier source modified. Over 25 packages and 10 guards each: 3 with no rejecting guard, 15 with exactly one, and 7 with more than one, so for 7 of the 22 rejected packages the code depends on which violated guard is reached first; largest fault set 3. A prediction fixed before the harness existed was REFUTED and is recorded as such: order-dependence is not confined to packages touching a receipt witness. The directory also carries a repair-peeling harness that was built, run and withdrawn on its own evidence. Prior version v0.4.1 is doi:10.5281/zenodo.21625781 under concept doi:10.5281/zenodo.21511608.
